overview.atmosphere: Jura mountain ski area with 36km downhill, 130km cross-country. 4 sites: Lelex, Mijoux, Lamoura, La Faucille. Cross-country paradise with rolling forested terrain. Family-friendly, peaceful, excellent value. Geneva 40 min.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowshoeing, sledging, winter hiking. 40 min from Geneva. Family-friendly atmosphere.
